canonicalCover.usage: authoritative visual source for README hero, changelog release art, Open Graph cards, repository release notes, and package announcements
rules: Use the approved artwork verbatim whenever a 1200x630 release asset is required.
Do not redraw the composition from primitive SVG shapes.
Do not substitute a generic mascot, white silhouette, alternate cavern, or generic cyberpunk scene.
Do not regenerate typography, feature cards, mascot placement, portal placement, or footer layout independently when the canonical artwork is available.

Derivative formats may crop or contain the canonical artwork, but must preserve the title, release badge, stitched voodoo-doll mascot, feature cards, and repository footer whenever the target format permits.
